name: through-object pass
description: Camera advances through an opening in the foreground object to reveal the subject beyond.

prompt.default: The camera pushes forward through a gap between foreground elements that are already in the scene, such as leaves, an archway or a doorway, which sweep past the lens and out of frame to reveal the subject beyond. No new objects appear.
